google_context.interpretation: Search was not in current operating decline, but AI capital intensity and long-run search disruption remain legitimate risks.

microsoft_context.interpretation: Highest-quality broad AI platform in the watchlist, but already held through JQUA and additive direct exposure raises household technology concentration.

LRCX.quality_note: Net cash; share count declined; service/support is about 30% of revenue.
LRCX.principal_risk: Wafer-fab cycle and 35% China revenue exposure.
LRCX.verdict: Best valuation/quality trade-off; watch for a better entry.

KLAC.quality_note: Highest margins in the set; about $4.04B primary-source TTM FCF; share count declined.
KLAC.principal_risk: Semiconductor capital-equipment cycle and a richer current multiple than LRCX.
KLAC.verdict: Best moat and cash economics; watch for a better entry.

ANET.quality_note: Debt-free balance sheet and exceptional margins.
ANET.principal_risk: Two customers were 42% of FY2025 revenue; premium valuation.
ANET.verdict: Excellent company, but too expensive and concentrated at this price.

ARM.quality_note: Dominant CPU instruction-set ecosystem and 97% GAAP gross margin.
ARM.principal_risk: SBC was $343M in the quarter and valuation assumes extraordinary growth.
ARM.verdict: Avoid at this valuation; GAAP/non-GAAP gap is too large.

MRVL.quality_note: Strong data-center growth and positive quarterly free cash flow.
MRVL.principal_risk: SBC was 11.9% of revenue; diluted shares rose 5.8%; customer/distributor concentration.
MRVL.verdict: Watch, not a quality-sleeve buy; dilution and non-GAAP dependence are material.

LITE.quality_note: Very rapid optical-component growth and strong guided operating margin.
LITE.principal_risk: FY free cash flow was only $300M; common shares rose 27%; two customers were 42% of revenue.
LITE.verdict: Avoid for this sleeve; optics upside is paired with dilution and weak cash yield.

COHR.quality_note: Lowest sales multiple in the group and strong optical demand.
COHR.principal_risk: FY free cash flow was about -$1.02B; net debt and heavy capital spending; shares rose 26%.
COHR.verdict: Watch for cash-flow proof; apparent cheapness is not yet quality.

SIVR.fee_note: 0.30% reflects a voluntary sponsor waiver that has existed since inception.
SIVR.structure: Physical silver trust; all silver was held at ICBC or a sub-custodian at 2026-03-31.

SLV.use: Best for a short tactical trade or options because volume is much higher.

PSLV.structure: Closed-end Canadian trust holding fully allocated LGD silver bars.
PSLV.use: Do not default to it in U.S. taxable: PFIC/QEF election and annual Form 8621 burden.

OneGold.minimum_storage_fee: $5 per quarter at the account level
OneGold.use: Custody diversification for a long-term holding; compare the live buy/sell spread before purchase.

recommended_policy.active_variant_only_if_monitoring_cycle: 4.5% JQUA + up to 1.0% LRCX, funded dollar-for-dollar from JQUA
recommended_policy.current_action: Keep JQUA; do not buy any of the seven direct names merely because of the one-day decline.

watch_entries.LRCX: Re-underwrite near $205 or when confirmed earnings reduce the GAAP forward multiple to about 22x.
watch_entries.KLAC: Re-underwrite near $140 or when confirmed earnings reduce the GAAP forward multiple to about 25x.

recommended_policy.silver_action: Do not add incremental silver while WPM remains at 154 shares; its illustrative silver revenue look-through is already about 1.38% of the portfolio.
